Name: Void's weird Wonders - Craftables (CP and AT)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[size=3][b][u]INFORMATION[/u]: [i]This mod still works in 1.6(you may just need to change the Format in the content.json). It will not be updated further though.[/i][/b][/size]

Here I am again once more bringing the weirdness( [i]and yoba knows what kind exactly[/i]) to your doorstep. This time with a little retexture of the craftables in a more or less odd and maybe creepy way, who knows! It is what is says on the tin, the entire tilesheet of craftables, as well as the sprinklers, enricher, nozzle and a little crabpot tweak to fit into the color theme as well.

Maybe not for everyone, but that's fine. I just felt like doing it and wanted to share some weirdness with the world, haha! Enjoy!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
